description: List the trigger events ("what happened": summons served, motion hearing date, trial date, notice of entry of judgment served...) that a court's deadline rules run from, for one rule set (TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL). Each trigger shows how many deadlines it starts, whether the service method changes the dates, and, for broad triggers, the kinds you can narrow to (for a motion hearing: noticed motion, summary judgment...). Use with deadlines_from_trigger. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

county.description: California county slug for local rules, e.g. "los-angeles" (CA sets only)

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, 1dca to 6dca

query.description: Optional words to filter triggers, e.g. "subpoena" or "served"
